people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

translations.web: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
translations.bsb: There Jacob built an altar, and he called that place El-bethel, because it was there that God had revealed Himself to Jacob as he fled from his brother.
translations.kjv: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
translations.asv: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el; because there God was revealed unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
